scope: First linked stop that covers a complete retrospective evidence excerpt for a given IIRC anchor.

forecast_row.methods: per-method conditional event probabilities aligned to linked stops only, in ascending character order

acceptance.bootstrap: 10,000 paired resamples grouped by connected article family
acceptance.explicit_anchor_requirement: Upper paired NLL difference bound below zero vs same joined-path model using linked text states without explicit anchor vectors
acceptance.same_document_swaps: Descriptive only. A transfer gain does not establish identity-specific prediction.
